title: Q6
description:
“For the word of God is living and powerful, and sharper than any two-edged sword.”
Read: Isa 49:2, Isa 55:10–11
a) The Servant says, “He has made My mouth like a sharp sword.” Isaiah says Yahweh's word “shall not return to Me void.” What do these bring forward about the word that has just spoken Psa 95's “Today”?
